messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (P1) detected: recurrent region fallback loop observed: us-east -> us-west -> eu -> us-east. High error rate + increased latency for customers pinned to 'stable' variant. Auto-fallback policy firing repeatedly. Alert: https://metrics.redwood.example/alerts/2462005432

alice (oncall-sre): paging in. I'm taking on-call. starting triage now. Can someone drop the current routing policy config? need to know if cross-region fallbacks are enabled for this tenant cohort.

bob (runtime-engineer): saw the same in the metrics dashboard. A subset of requests started failing healthchecks in us-east app layer around 02:13 UTC, then routing moved traffic to us-west, then eu, then back. Looks like the liveness probe threshold is too aggressive when combined with short probe intervals.

carol (routing): putting the current effective policy here:
```
policy_id: fallback-v2
priority: [local, regional, global]
regional_fallbacks: true
healthcheck_threshold: 2_failures_in_10s
cooldown_window: 60s
max_hops: 3
```
I suspect `max_hops: 3` + short `cooldown_window` is enabling a sawtooth. Also noticed model-variant mapping mismatch in the routing table for some endpoints (stable -> variant-a but variant-a not available in us-east).

dave (support): several customers reported 500s and long tail latency. Customer-reported incident: frank (CS) pasted logs from a fintech customer showing repeated reroutes and invoice-generation timeouts.

frank (customer-success): yup, customer CL-329 reports intermittent failures starting ~02:14 UTC. They saw tokens failing with model mismatch error: `VariantMismatchError: requested model variant not found in region`. That lines up with bob/carol.

alice (oncall-sre): immediate mitigations — executing plan:
1) pause cross-region fallback for affected product routes (so requests fail-over to dedicated standby in same region only).
2) increase healthcheck threshold and cooldown to stop rapid flip-flop.
3) open a short-lived pin to keep routing to us-east while we stabilize.
Executing step 1 now.

carol (routing): acknowledged. issuing api call to update policy:
```
PATCH /routing/policies/fallback-v2
body: { "regional_fallbacks": false }
```
Response: 200 OK. regional_fallbacks=false applied to service group `prod/chat` at 02:18:12 UTC.

deploy-bot: deployment webhook: routing-config-service v1.18.3 rolled out to control-plane nodes (4/4) - 02:18:15 UTC.

bob (runtime-engineer): after policy toggle, I'm seeing a sharp drop in hop-count in the traces. latency is improving but there are still error spikes from local us-east model variant unavailability. I think the root cause: a model pack in us-east failed to load (OOM eviction) and our model-variant-to-region mapping incorrectly allowed fallback to variants that didn't exist in the original region, which caused VariantMismatchError when the request returned.

alice (oncall-sre): next step: increase healthcheck threshold on the us-east workers from 2_failures_in_10s -> 5_failures_in_30s and bump cooldown_window to 300s. Carol — can you apply?

carol (routing): applying now. PATCH returned 200. new config:
```
healthcheck_threshold: 5_failures_in_30s
cooldown_window: 300s
max_hops: 2
```
This should reduce thrash.

bob (runtime-engineer): I'm also restarting the affected model shards in us-east (shard-47, shard-52). Restart commands:
```
for s in shard-47 shard-52; do ssh gpu-$s "systemctl restart redwood-model-service"; done
```
Restart in progress — will monitor logs.

dave (support): I'm drafting a brief to customers in impacted orgs. frank, can you coordinate the CL-329 update?

frank (customer-success): on it. I'll post a message to the customer with details and ETA ~20m for stabilization.

eve (product): any customer-facing degradation beyond elevated latency and some 500s? need to decide if we should trigger broader incident communications.

bob (runtime-engineer): error budget hit for some customers, but after toggles error rate dropped from 8.2% -> 1.1% in ~4 minutes. No broad data loss. No persisted corruption.

alice (oncall-sre): good. keep monitoring for 30m. If errors remain above 1% will escalate to SEV2 and involve infra. Right now mitigation looks effective.

bob (runtime-engineer): logs from the restarted shards show the model server failed to allocate KV cache due to a memory fragmentation path; we have a patch (PR #1127) that adds a guard and better fallback to quantized cache. Suggest fast-tracking the PR to staging and a canary rollout to us-east.

carol (routing): routing policy PR to avoid mapping to unavailable variants: PR #1142 adds a preflight check during routing decision: ensure variant availability in region before applying fallback rules. Recommend merging after validation.

alice (oncall-sre): operational checklist:
- [x] regional_fallbacks disabled for affected services
- [x] healthcheck threshold and cooldown increased
- [x] restarted affected model shards
- [x] notified customers (CS/SUPPORT)
- [ ] merge PR #1127 to staging and canary
- [ ] merge PR #1142 and monitor for regressions
- [ ] postmortem owner assigned (bob)

dave (support): customer update sent to CL-329: "We've applied short-term mitigations and are monitoring; a patch is being prepared. We'll follow up with a postmortem."

frank (customer-success): customer replied: appreciates quick action, asks if there will be an SLA credit. I'll loop legal if needed.

eve (product): flagged as potential product-level risk: fallback policies need stronger guardrails and better observability when fallbacks chain across regions. Adding build-of-record to roadmap.

alice (oncall-sre): leaving handoff notes for next oncall: mitigation toggles applied, PRs to land, postmortem. tagging @bob as owner for postmortem. I will un-assign on-call after 02:55 UTC.

bob (runtime-engineer): taking postmortem and follow-ups. immediate next steps: run memory fragmentation repro in staging, cut PR #1127, run canary in us-east with 10% traffic. Also add a new alert for VariantMismatchError spikes.

incident-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged by alice (oncall-sre). Pager duty runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.example/region-fallback-loop.

alice (oncall-sre): closing ongoing pager for now — mitigation appears effective. Will convert this thread to postmortem-draft channel once initial writeup is ready.

deploy-bot: healthcheck: us-east model-service shards back to normal (0 evictions) — 02:28:56 UTC.

bob (runtime-engineer): final note: root cause summary (short): combination of aggressive healthcheck thresholds, `max_hops` allowing 3-region loop, and routing mapping that didn't verify variant availability. Consequence: sawtooth fallback loop and VariantMismatchErrors. Fix: config hardening, mapping preflight, and model-server memory guard.

alice (oncall-sre): last update before handoff: monitoring window passes. leaving channel. Thanks team. :heart:
